<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak at m/z 268.1939 likely corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈267.1867 Da. The formula that best matches this mass while being consistent with the observed isotopic pattern (≈20 % M+1 intensity, suggesting ~16‑18 carbons) is C₁₆H₂₇O₃.</thought>
<final_answer>C16H27O3</final_answer>
